notes: p95 latency is the 95th-percentile end-to-end response time as reported by k6's http_req_duration trend.
p99 escrow release is measured against POST /api/v1/admin/escrow/:id/release.
max_fail_rate is the upper bound for k6's http_req_failed rate across the load run.
These numbers are budgets, not observed measurements. Set LOADTEST_BASE_URL and LOADTEST_DATABASE_URL plus install the k6 binary to run scripts/verify-load.sh against a real environment.
